description: This file defines and manages a catalog of machine learning models, including functions to discover models via API calls, cache results, and build model definitions. It includes model metadata such as IDs, reasoning capabilities, input modalities, context window sizes, and costs.

methods.name: buildChutesModelDefinition
methods.description: Enhances a model configuration with compatibility support information.

methods.name: discoverChutesModels
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches and caches a list of model definitions from a remote API, with fallback to static catalog on failure.
